queries.name: job_status_only
queries.sql: UPDATE jobs SET status='failed',updated_at='2001-01-01' WHERE id='retained-job-1'

foreground_dml.scope: status-only update and one job/preview insert; each actual EXPLAIN executes triggers then rolls back

source_ttl.distribution: retained pinned prefix then200 expired eligible sources

query.name: source_retention
query.sql:
WITH source_retention_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT source.id FROM sources source
 WHERE source.created_at<now()-($1*interval '1 second')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE source_id=source.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM storage_reservations WHERE kind='preview' AND job_id=source.id)
 ORDER BY source.created_at LIMIT $2
)
DELETE FROM sources AS source WHERE source.id=ANY(ARRAY(SELECT id FROM source_retention_candidates))
RETURNING source.path,source.thumbnail_path,source.owner
